description: PURPOSE: Legacy Android-only alias of screenshot, kept so older prompts keep working. Prefer screenshot({ device }): same capture and pressables summary, on every platform.

device.description: Alias for `deviceId` — same accepted values. Provided for consistency with tap/get_screen_state/ios_screenshot, which all accept `device`. If both are given, `deviceId` wins.

deviceId.description: Android target: adb serial, emulator name, or RN device substring. Omit for first.

outputPath.description: Optional path to save the screenshot. If not provided, saves to temp directory.

name: android_screenshot
